infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: Porterchain notifies you when a job is assigned or a stop changes.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: While you are on duty, PorterChain sends your location to PorterChain dispatch so the van can be seen on the map.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: PorterChain needs background location while you are on duty so PorterChain dispatch can see the van with the screen locked.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: PorterChain needs background location while you are on duty so PorterChain dispatch can see the van with the screen locked.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: PorterChain uses the camera to scan parcel labels at pickup and delivery and to take proof-of-delivery photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo library access is used when attaching proof of delivery images.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Porterchain uses Face ID to unlock your saved driver session on this device.
